blender.units: metres as shipped by each source; Z up

islands.source: StreakByte 'Low Poly Floating Islands' (Unity Asset Store, bought by Georg)
islands.licence: Unity Asset Store EULA: use in a commercial game is fine, also outside Unity; raw files (FBX, textures, rebuilt .blend) are NOT redistributed, so they stay local and never go to GitHub
islands.rawFiles: KFB Island Worldbuilder Lab/donors/streakbyte-floating-islands/tree/Assets/Low Poly Floating Islands/ (Models/*.fbx, one shared palette texture Lowpoly_Flaoting_Islands_PortTexture.png)
islands.layout: KFB Island Worldbuilder Lab/public/assets/streakbyte/scenes/<scene>.json (the Lab's extraction of the 8 Unity demo scenes: fbx, unit scale, 4x4 matrix per item)
islands.rebuild: Blender object matrix = C · M_unity · diag(-1,1,1) · scale(u), C swaps Y/Z; checked visually (props sit on the ground). All 8 scenes rebuilt; item counts match the Lab index (141/96/107/56/134/72/94/74).
islands.metricsNote: flat = up-facing terrain (normal z > 0.94), sampled every 0.5 m; level = most common height band; r = radius of the largest flat circle on the main level

characters.eyesRule: Toy Soldier and Orcs get the KFB eyes in any render; Step A renders no character bodies for that reason

toySoldier.windupKey: separate mesh 'ToySoldier_WindupKey', rigidly parented to bone 'chest' (no skin weights): can be hidden, detached or 'stolen' on a copy without touching the source
toySoldier.hatAndPlume: plume is part of the 'ToySoldier_Hat' mesh (red shako, white plume, gold trim); no separate plume object
toySoldier.hatNumber: UNTESTED: no number in the source; the flat shako front can take a decal or texture patch
toySoldier.colour: uniform red #d3252a from the shared palette texture; cobalt No.1 = palette swap on a copy of the texture (UNTESTED)

frostOrc.status: NO 'Frost Orc' asset. Candidates: KayKit texture variant B

frostOrc.large: Orc Brute (Series 6 1.1, Rig_Large): orcbrute_texture_B.png gives grey-teal skin #73a1a7 (A is green #5cb869)
